observations: A single tyre wrapped in blue plastic film.
The tread pattern is visible at the top and appears unused.
A yellow and blue label is affixed to the wrapping.
Label indicates 'Made in Indonesia' and carries an 'SNI' mark.
A watermark 'NWAMBU SAMUEL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Quality is subjective and Accelera is generally positioned as a budget brand.
A seller's guarantee cannot be enforced or verified through a remote photo.

risks.risk: The tyre may be old stock (expired rubber).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as expired stock (over 5 years old).

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage or internal repairs under the wrapping.
risks.proof: Photos of the unwrapped tyre showing both sidewalls and the inner liner.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a minor structural defect or previous repair.

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT manufacture code on the sidewall.
Photos of the tyre unwrapped to inspect the sidewalls for bulges or cuts.
Photo of the inside of the tyre to check for patches or plugs.
response.reason: The brand, model, and size are clearly legible on the manufacturer's label. It can be priced as a single new-old-stock unit.
